name: Network Resilience Testing
purpose: Prove networked systems survive packet loss, latency spikes, jitter, partitions, and reconnect storms using fault injection, jittered backoff, idempotent operations, and measured recovery objectives.
inputs: Fault profiles: loss percent, delay mean plus jitter, duplication, corruption, partition duration, disconnect frequency
Retry and timeout inventory per dependency: attempts, backoff base and cap, jitter strategy, idempotency coverage
Recovery objectives: detection time, reconnect time, catch-up time, acceptable data loss in operations
Test harness: Toxiproxy or tc/netem scripts, seeded chaos scenarios, staging topology matching production hops
outputs: Chaos scenario suite runnable in CI with deterministic seeds and pass/fail thresholds
Retry, timeout, and queue configuration with documented budgets
Recovery report proving RTO compliance or honest gap analysis
stop_conditions: All profiles pass with RTO met, duplicate rate under 0.01 percent, reconnect storm within accept budget
Fault exposes a design flaw (non-idempotent mutation, unbounded queue) requiring implementation rework
